footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to People Inc: includes $15.3M from discontinued operations; after $2.6M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 8.7% to $2.4B in 2025. Gross margin was 66.2%, versus 61.8% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $97.4M from $28.7M.
The net loss narrowed to $104M, or −$1.30 per share, from $540M. Operating cash flow was $64.0M and free cash flow $44.8M, versus $340M; People Inc returned $315M through buybacks.
sources: People Incorporated Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
